decision_signal.signal: filtered history label of the previous month (one-month lag)

units.x: per-side cost, bps of traded notional (40% commission, 60% half spread) + 1.0 bps/$1m slippage
units.z: paired dCE vs buy-and-hold at the same cost

no_trade.rule: trade iff 0.5*gamma*d'Sigma d*12*W > estimated cost, Sigma from the calibration window
no_trade.error_rate_note: per-decision error rates are not identified; holdout dCE on disjoint evaluation paths is reported instead

risk_meta.estimation: Sigma estimated on the calibration window only (1977-03-31..2026-09-30); applied ex ante

validation.method: trailing-60m covariance at each year start vs realised vol over the next 12 months

warnings: model_generated: some return series are repriced from public yields (not observed total returns)
